rule_title: TTP 1555 - Remote Browser Credential Sweep via C$ Network Share (DonPapi)
description: Detects DonPapi accessing browser saved credential stores remotely over the C$ share. The tool sweeps Chrome User Data, Firefox profiles.ini, and Firefox-based browser variants (Cyberfox, IceDragon, K-Meleon, BlackHawk, Icecat) across every user profile on the target host.
